notes: NEW Women's IC Champion via clean succession over Becky (Nemesis). Helios ascends; the prophecy ('Lynch will know the next generation is here') fulfilled. The renaissance/youth-elevation beat on the flagship -- and the card's only clean title change.

name: Jacob Fatu -- absorbed into the Bloodline (aitu domesticated)
notes: The aitu neutered -> domesticated -> absorbed, by his own acceptance (ramp beat). Now at the BACK of the family pecking order; rematch hooks = the hand-injury + 'robbed by a foul.' WATCH the rendering (dignified subordination vs JYD/degradation -- worked-shoot-discrimination-blindness).

name: Bloodline realignment -- Usos+Fatu in, MFT out
notes: Post-Tribal-Combat: Roman + Usos + absorbed-Fatu = the new core; Solo's MFT remnant left outside-looking-in (front row). Roman acknowledged the MFT with no conflict but did not bring them in = the pecking-order statement.

name: King of the Ring 2026
notes: Payoff intent: KOTR winner earns an Undisputed WWE Title shot (Jey's stated path: challenge Cody at SummerSlam). Bracket opened on the post-Clash Raw (6/1). R1 Raw: Oba Femi def. Solo Sikoa/Penta/Carmelo Hayes. R1 SmackDown: Dominik Mysterio. Next Raw (6/8) R1: Rollins vs Je'Von Evans vs Ricky Saints vs Talla Tonga. SOURCE-SPLIT on the FINAL venue: results outlets say Night of Champions (Riyadh); angle recaps say SummerSlam.

name: Queen of the Ring 2026
notes: Payoff intent: QOTR winner earns a Women's World Title shot (vs the champ at SummerSlam per angle recaps; final venue source-split). Opened 6/1. R1 Raw: Iyo Sky def. Giulia/Roxanne Perez/Lash Legend. Next Raw (6/8) R1: Becky Lynch vs Liv Morgan vs Alexa Bliss vs Chelsea Green (Becky's post-IC-loss landing spot).

name: Jey's KOTR road to Cody
notes: Payoff intent: Jey wins KOTR -> challenges Cody Rhodes for the Undisputed WWE Title at SummerSlam. Roman tasked Jey (solo; Jimmy kept at Roman's side) to take 'the other end of the table' -- Cody's title. The Bloodline pointed at Cody.

name: Jey / Fatu friction (kept tension)
notes: Payoff intent: Jey/Fatu tension resurfaces despite the Bloodline reunion. On the acknowledgment Raw, Fatu pointedly said he lost to his Tribal Chief, 'not Jey's punk ass'; Jimmy called the induction a 'warning shot.' Latent intra-Bloodline tension preserved.

name: Sol Ruca vs Lyra Valkyria (Women's IC)
notes: Payoff intent: Lyra Valkyria challenges Sol Ruca for the Women's Intercontinental Title. Lyra (the FIRST-ever Women's IC Champion, who 'couldn't challenge while Becky held it') asked Ruca for a shot; Ruca accepted. Lyra left Bayley hanging to do it.

name: Rey Mysterio vs Penta (Intercontinental Title)
notes: Payoff intent: Rey Mysterio challenges Penta for the (men's) Intercontinental Title. Adam Pearce told Penta he's arranging Rey vs Penta for the IC Title; Rey & Dragon Lee beat Page & Rusev to position it.

name: LA Knight vs the favored family (authority bias)
register: the people's voice vs the favored family
notes: Payoff intent: LA Knight pushes against perceived Bloodline favoritism / authority bias. Knight accused Pearce of favoring the Bloodline and ignoring him; threatened to 'take Pearce out of retirement.' Pearce called Fatu 'a liability.' Anti-Bloodline/anti-authority voice seeded.

name: Judgment Day internal fracture
notes: Payoff intent: Judgment Day splits (Perez vs Liv; Raquel in the middle; Liv/Dom 'power couple'). Post-QOTR-loss, Roxanne ('I was supposed to be Queen') clashed with Liv & Raquel; Liv hyped herself + Dom as 'King and Queen of the Ring.' Fracture seeded.

name: Montez Ford / Seth Rollins alliance
notes: Payoff intent: Montez Ford aligns with Rollins out of the Vision wreckage (Street Profits implications). Ford flew in to take out Austin Theory and save Rollins in the main event; the two put differences aside, Rollins acknowledged him. Watch Profits fallout.

name: Heyman / Breakker tension
register: the Oracle and the beast misfire
notes: Payoff intent: Breakker/Heyman crack after Bron spears Heyman through the barricade. In the main event Breakker accidentally speared Heyman through the ringside barricade; seeds tension within the Vision's remainder.

name: Tony D'Angelo's NXT Title reign
notes: Payoff intent: D'Angelo's reign tested by a challenger gauntlet (Hendrix, Rook) + the Naraku question. D'Angelo won the NXT Title at Stand & Deliver (4/4/26). Now fielding Hendrix/Rook while Naraku appoints himself 'protector.'

name: D'Angelo & Naraku -- 'destined to war'
notes: Payoff intent: Naraku's 'protection' resolves into a title challenge / betrayal. Naraku says he'll keep D'Angelo champion because they're 'destined to go to war'; clotheslined Hendrix and bowed to the champ. Alliance-or-betrayal slow burn.

name: D'Angelo vs Kam Hendrix (NXT Title)
notes: Payoff intent: Hendrix's NXT Title shot (set for the 6/2 NXT). Title match booked for the following week's TV; Mason Rook & Naraku both circling.

name: Mason Rook forces into the title picture
notes: Payoff intent: Rook takes 'matters into his own hands' for a title shot. Demanded the D'Angelo shot from GM Robert Stone (claimed a technical pin); Naraku blocked him from ruining the title match.

name: Saquon Shugars vs DarkState (revenge)
notes: Payoff intent: Shugars' revenge on DarkState for the ousting. DarkState ousted Shugars (announce-table beatdown 5/19); 5/26 closed with Shugars silhouetted on a production truck, watching = the revenge hook.

name: DarkState hunt the champions
notes: Payoff intent: DarkState targets NXT champions; near-term feud w/ Borne & Heights. Maskless promo justified ousting Shugars (collegiate athletes vs the 'indie' guy); refocused on hunting gold; ambushed Borne & Heights backstage.

name: Lola Vice's NXT Women's reign
notes: Payoff intent: Vice defends against a forming contender logjam (Dame/Jordan/Grey/Armstrong). Vice won the title at S&D (4/4/26); retained vs Izzi Dame 5/26 (overbooked, Culling interference). Kali Armstrong declaring for both women's titles.

name: Tatum Paxley vs Zaria (Women's NA Title)
register: the obsessive champ vs the stalking power
notes: Payoff intent: Zaria challenges Paxley for the Women's North American Title. Zaria attacked Paxley & Lizzy Rain and grabbed the belt; Paxley/Rain alliance formed in response. Near-term TV: Lizzy Rain vs Zaria.

name: Speed Title No. 1 Contender Tournament
notes: Payoff intent: Tournament winner challenges Lexis King for the WWE (men's) Speed Title. 5/26: Romeo Moreno (w/ Noam Dar) beat returning Nathan Frazer; Sean Legacy vs Dorian Van Dux went to a 3-min draw (both eliminated). Pointed at Lexis King.

name: The 'Mr. NXT' Pageant (Hill vs Angels)
notes: Payoff intent: Shiloh Hill vs Tristan Angels at the 'Mr. NXT' pageant (booked ~2 wks out). Hill (cowboy) pushed a joke petition; Angels (posh 'Mr. England') mocked it. Hill beat Dempsey 5/26; GM Robert Stone approved the pageant.

name: The Culling vs OTM
notes: Payoff intent: The Culling vs OTM tag war (+ Spears-rogue tension inside the Culling). Shawn Spears blindsided OTM with a chair pre-bell (scrapping their match); OTM retaliated during the main event. Izzi Dame papered over Spears' rogue 'timing.'

name: Natalya & Layla Diggs vs Jaida Parker
notes: Payoff intent: Natalya (w/ Diggs) steps back in vs Jaida Parker. Diggs debuted 5/26 (lost to Parker); Nattie aligned with her; Parker/Nattie staredown teases the vet's in-ring return.

name: Kendal Grey / Wren Sinclair friendship breakup
notes: Payoff intent: Best-friends Grey & Sinclair tip into a singles feud. Sinclair (Speed Champ, working hurt) attacked Grey from behind to set a singles match -- classic teased-betrayal seed.
